name: Tamper-evident storage
description: The adversary is trying to tamper-evident his storage to be able to detect any tampering.

subtechniques.name: Lay objects following a straight line and compare
subtechniques.description: To detect tampering with assets, they might be placed following a straight line to be able to compare them when you return.

subtechniques.name: Pencil eraser to detect tampering
subtechniques.description: Pencil eraser debris might be placed on purpose to detect tampering with physical documents or books (see if they moved or are gone).
